pilot: ARIS4C015 Pilot 1 historical title lexical-novelty ablation
interpretation: Simple title lexical novelty does not provide a stable improvement over the strongest citation-only baseline for delayed-recognition consensus.
Nearest-3 lexical distance is approximately tied with the best citation baseline on awakening in this exploratory sample, but variance is high.
Lexical OOV share approaches but does not beat the strongest citation baseline on immediate future acceleration.
The 100-title prior corpus leaves substantial vocabulary out-of-coverage; this feature family should receive a prior-corpus-size sensitivity test before being declared definitively uninformative.
No weighted lexical novelty composite is introduced post hoc.
claim_boundary: Transparent lexical proxy with a small historical reference corpus; not an embedding novelty measure and not evidence of scientific importance.
